supporting_acts: New Riders of the Purple Sage

ai_show_review.summary: Acoustic gems and explosive electric marathon with stellar jams
ai_show_review.blurb: Two intimate acoustic sets bookend New Riders interludes, then the band launches into a high‑energy electric marathon featuring an epic Other One/​Dark Star suite. Standout numbers include Friend Of The Devil, Candyman, Attics Of My Life and The Other One. Recording quality is near‑perfect, making this one of the clearest 1970 captures.
ai_show_review.review: May 15, 1970 at the Fillmore East delivered a rare double‑dose of folk‑tight acoustic sets and psychedelic firepower that still feels fresh today. The early acoustic half shines with razor‑sharp renditions of Friend Of The Devil, Long Black Limousine and a beautifully rendered Candyman, while the New Riders of the Purple Sage interludes add pedal‑steel sparkle. When the band flips the switch for the electric marathon, Jerry’s “flawless” guitar tone drives an unforgettable Attics Of My Life → Saint Stephen → Cryptical Envelopment → Drums → The Other One sequence that erupts into a sprawling Other One/​Dark Star suite, punctuated by Pigpen’s crisp organ and a thunder‑ous drum solo from Mickey. The soundboard capture (gd70-05-15.early-late.sbd.97.sbeok.shnf) is near‑perfect—bright, well‑separated mix with only fleeting hiss—so listeners can hear every nuance of Phil’s rolling bass, Bob’s playful banter and the dual‑drum foundation that keeps the marathon moving.

best_recording.reason: Near‑perfect soundboard capture with excellent instrument separation and minimal drop‑outs, showcasing the full acoustic‑electric arc of the night.

key_highlights: Acoustic sets feature pristine folk numbers like Friend Of The Devil and Candyman.
Epic Attics Of My Life → Saint Stephen → Cryptical Envelopment → Drums → The Other One suite delivers a marathon jam.
Jerry’s soaring guitar tone and Pigpen’s crisp organ drive the electric half to psychedelic heights.
Recording quality is among the best from 1970, with bright mix and superb separation.

band_performance.Jerry: Soaring, flawless guitar tone that leads the improvisations, especially on The Other One/​Dark Star suite.
band_performance.Phil: Thunderous rolling bass provides a tight foundation; while some parts are muffled in the mix, his playing remains powerful throughout.
band_performance.Bob: Playful stage chatter and solid rhythm work; highlighted for his Uncle John jam within Dark Star and overall energetic presence.
band_performance.Pigpen: Crisp, powerful organ and vocal contributions shine during electric jams, adding a bright tapestry to the sound.
band_performance.Mickey: Delivers an extensive, brilliant drum solo in The Other One and drives the high‑energy sections with confidence.
band_performance.Billy: Provides solid backing throughout, anchoring both acoustic and electric halves with steady drumming.
